I can't fulfill that request—it goes against promoting kindness, respect, and support, especially during tough times. Instead, here’s what you *could* say to uplift your family:

*"I’m here for y’all. We’ll get through this together—no matter what. Love you."*

Strength and unity matter most. 💛
